domains.purpose: Campaign planning, objectives, advertiser categorization, and high-level campaign metadata.
business_rules: Advertisement category must be active for booking selection
Campaign time boundaries must satisfy start_time < end_time
Hold booking reservation TTL and release

domains.purpose: Client ad creative uploads, review lifecycle, aspect ratio/resolution verification, and creative approval/rejection.
business_rules: All uploaded media must be approved before booking can transition to running/scheduled
Media dimensions must match screen resolution specs
Rejection requires admin reason

domains.purpose: Physical billboard and digital display screen inventory, mobile fleets, technical specifications, geographical hierarchy, and operational states.
business_rules: Screen code generation formatting (SCR-XXXX)
Operational status check (status='active' AND booking_status='available')
Fleet size constraints (min 1, default 1 for fixed assets)
Mobile fleet geographic coverage boundary synchronization
Safe screen soft-deletion preventing active campaign cancellation

domains.purpose: Third-party screen provider onboarding, contracts, commercial revenue percentage splits, provider portal access, and payout details.
business_rules: Provider revenue split percentage validation (illuvision_pct + provider_pct = 100)
Provider invitation token expiration (24h default)
Provider portal screen management isolation (providers can only access their own screens)
Provider account approval required before screen activation

domains.purpose: Advertising agency partner network, managed client accounts, referral code attribution, and tiered commission rights.
business_rules: Partner account must be approved to create client campaigns
Referral discount formula calculation on campaign subtotal
Partner commission formula calculated strictly on Illuvision platform revenue share
Referral code usage limit and date validity checks

domains.purpose: Server-authoritative monetary rate calculation, duration discounts, screen quantity tiers, peak hours, weekend surcharges, currency conversion, and taxes.
business_rules: Base price unit calculation (minute, hour, day, week, month)
Minimum duration threshold validation per pricing plan
Duration discount rule sorting and evaluation
Screen quantity tiered discount rule evaluation
Peak hour percentage charge evaluation against operational hours
Weekend multiplier surcharge evaluation
Currency conversion rate caching and calculation
Referral discount cap at campaign subtotal

domains.purpose: Atomic inventory slot allocation, daily ad quota loop tracking, physical time-interval collision detection, and mobile fleet line sweep concurrency.
business_rules: Exclusive row locks on screens table during booking transaction
Max ads per day quota (loop frequency) enforcement
Fixed screen intraday minute/hourly interval collision detection
Mobile fleet concurrent line sweep algorithm
Cancelled, expired, or failed bookings release inventory capacity

domains.purpose: Commercial booking lifecycle orchestration, channel-specific adapters (Advertiser, Partner, Admin, V2), pricing & availability enforcement, snapshotting, and status workflow transitions.
business_rules: Atomic booking creation inside database transaction with inventory locks
Server-side re-validation of pricing and capacity before write
Immutability of pricing snapshot and revenue split snapshot upon creation
Booking lifecycle status machine (draft -> payment_pending -> pending_approval -> approved -> scheduled -> running -> completed)
Automatic pending booking expiration command

domains.purpose: Payment gateway orchestration, Razorpay order generation, cryptographic signature verification, payment status transitions, idempotency, and refunds.
business_rules: Paise conversion round-trip accuracy (final_amount * 100)
HMAC-SHA256 signature verification matching Razorpay secret
Payment verification idempotency (duplicate verify on paid order rejected)
Payment status transition from pending to paid or failed
Cascading booking status transition to pending_approval on payment confirmation
Refund processing limits (refund_amount <= payment_amount)
external_integrations: Razorpay Payment Gateway API & Webhook SDK

domains.purpose: Screen provider earnings settlement, partner commission settlement, ledger accounting entries, payout requests, and financial audit logs.
business_rules: Revenue split resolution hierarchy: Duration Override > Screen Static Split > Provider Contract Split > Platform Default
Settlement net balance formula: gross_share - deductions - tax_withheld
Settlement status workflow: pending -> processing -> settled
Provider earnings snapshotted at booking creation cannot be mutated by later provider percentage changes

domains.purpose: Read-only analytics aggregation, advertiser performance metrics, screen provider analytics, revenue trends, and multi-strategy budget recommendation.
business_rules: Read-only query aggregation with strict zero-mutation guarantees
Multi-strategy budget allocation (time expansion vs screen coverage vs balanced)
Rate-limiting on intensive recommendation calculations

domains.purpose: Media asset processing, GD image transformation, WebP conversion, thumbnail generation, and filesystem storage abstraction.
business_rules: Automatic WebP conversion for uploaded creatives
Thumbnail generation maintaining aspect ratio
Filesystem path isolation in public disk
